name: headroom
description: Alerts, asks or blocks as the context window fills and the rate-limit pace runs hot.

context_opportunity_at.title: Context opportunity at (%)
context_opportunity_at.description: Context window fill, in percent, where the opportunity level starts.

context_opportunity_action.title: Context opportunity action
context_opportunity_action.description: What headroom does at the context opportunity level: none, alert (toast, band and a note to Claude), ask (confirm once before the next tool call) or block (deny tool calls).

wake_at.title: Wake at (%)
wake_at.description: When the 5-hour window passes this percent, headroom wakes the session at its reset. 0 turns the timer off.
